facts.text: The hotel is attached to Mall of America.
facts.excerpt: Attached to Mall of America, our destination is ideal year-round!

facts.text: The hotel is located between the twin cities of Minneapolis and St. Paul, in an urban location with a suburban feel.
facts.excerpt: JW Marriott Minneapolis Mall of America is perfectly located between the twin cities of Minneapolis and St. Paul in an urban location with a suburban feel.

facts.text: Mall of America has over 520 shops and 50 restaurants under one roof.
facts.excerpt: It’s over 520 shops full of tax-free shopping and 50 restaurants full of delicious food and experiences – all under one roof.

facts.text: The hotel is directly connected to Mall of America shopping, including brands like Nordstrom and Chanel.
facts.excerpt: directly connected to the incredible shopping at Mall of America, including brands like Arc’teryx, Nordstrom, BOSS, Chanel and other luxury offerings.

facts.text: Minnesota Valley National Wildlife Refuge is less than a mile from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Less than a mile from the JW Marriott Minneapolis Mall of America is a thriving urban refuge where nature connects people, communities and wildlife.

facts.text: The hotel has second-floor skyway access to the mall.
facts.excerpt: And with second-floor skyway access to the Mall (right near the Nordstrom enrance, we might add)

facts.text: Many guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows, and all have deluxe bedding.
facts.excerpt: Many of our 342 elegantly furnished guest rooms include floor-to-ceiling windows, and they all offer deluxe bedding and a host of premium amenities.

facts.text: Every guest room has a soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: Every one of our 342 guest rooms are accommodated with a luxurious and peaceful soaking tub

facts.text: The suites have Italian marble bathrooms with stand-alone tubs and separate marble showers.
facts.excerpt: The luxury suites are appointed with spacious bathrooms clad in Italian marble, featuring stand-alone tubs, separate marble showers, expansive mirrors, terry bathrobes, and world-class toiletries.

facts.text: The Presidential Suites include a full parlor with a spacious dining table.
facts.excerpt: including a full parlor with a spacious dining table.

facts.text: The 15th-floor Concierge Lounge has views of the Twin Cities.
facts.excerpt: The 15th floor Concierge Lounge offers amazing views of the Twin Cities

facts.text: From the Concierge Lounge guests can watch the planes go by.
facts.excerpt: Watch the planes go by as you indulge in breakfast or a snack when you enjoy our Concierge Lounge.

facts.text: Cedar + Stone, Urban Table is inspired by Minnesota's natural surroundings and relationships with farmers within 200 miles.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by a fusion of culinary cultures, Minnesota's natural surroundings and relationships with farmers within 200 miles, Cedar + Stone, Urban Table creates a vibrant dining experience

facts.text: Cedar + Stone, Urban Table has won Wine Spectator Awards every year since opening in 2016 and has an on-site sommelier.
facts.excerpt: Cedar + Stone, Urban Table has proudly won Wine Spectator Awards every year since opening in 2016. Not sure how to pair? Our on-site Sommelier is happy to help with recommendations.

facts.text: Babylon Micro-Farms at Cedar + Stone grow greens and herbs steps from the table.
facts.excerpt: Our Babylon Micro-Farms flourish just steps from your table, bringing the freshest greens and herbs straight from seed to plate.

facts.text: The Lobby Lounge serves Midwest craft beers and liquors and a light menu.
facts.excerpt: We serve an impressive selection of the Midwest's best craft beers and liquors, as well as a light restaurant menu.

facts.text: The hotel has a heated indoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in our indoor swimming pool to help revitalize your mind, body and spirit.

facts.text: The fitness studio is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
facts.excerpt: Open 7 days a week 24-hours a day.

facts.text: Guests arriving are met with an exclusive scent and sound created by Flamingo Estate for JW Marriott.
facts.excerpt: Experience the exclusive scent and sound created by Flamingo Estate for JW Marriott.

facts.text: Minneapolis-St Paul International Airport is about 5.7 miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: MSP is located approximately 5.7 Miles from the hotel.

facts.text: Downtown Minneapolis is about 10 minutes away by light rail.
facts.excerpt: Take the light rail over to downtown Minneapolis, just 10 minutes away, to keep the party going.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at JW Marriott Minneapolis Mall of America.

facts.text: The hotel has nearly 20,000 sq. ft. of event space.
facts.excerpt: Discover almost 20,000 square feet of meeting space, including our beautiful Diamond Ballroom and 12 breakout rooms.

facts.text: The hotel opened in November 2015.
facts.excerpt: The hotel, which opened in November 2015, is luring fun-seeking families and businessmen alike

facts.text: Rooms are steel-gray with dark wooden furniture and marble bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Steel-gray rooms have dark wooden furniture and houndstooth-print pillows, along with marble bathrooms and LED screen TVs.

facts.text: The hotel holds the AAA Four Diamond award for 2025.
facts.excerpt: AAA Four Diamond 2025
